_meta.description: Time-sensitive figures used by lotsofcalcs.com. Nothing here is hardcoded into a page — every calculator that needs a rate reads it from this file and displays the date it applies from.

conventions.effectiveFrom: ISO date the figure came into force, per the source.
conventions.lastVerified: ISO date this figure was last checked against the primary source. null means it is a best estimate that has NOT been verified and must not be relied on.
conventions.source: URL of the primary source — the platform or authority's own published schedule, never a third-party summary.

_meta.warning: Entries with lastVerified: null were compiled from secondary sources because the primary source was unreachable. Check each one before treating the output as accurate.

ebay-uk.name: eBay UK
ebay-uk.notes: Business seller fees are quoted excluding VAT and 20% VAT is added. Private sellers have paid no final value fee, per-order fee or regulatory fee on domestic listings since October 2024 — the buyer pays a Buyer Protection Fee instead, which does not come out of the seller's payout.

private.label: Private seller
private.note: No seller fees on domestic listings. Vehicles are the exception and are not modelled here.

perOrderFee.note: Rose to 40p for orders over £10 in February 2026.

ebay-uk.categoryRangeNote: Published category rates run from about 6.9% to 14.9%. Only a few are listed here — use the custom rate box for anything else.

promotedListings.note: Promoted Listings Standard is charged on the total order value when the sale is attributed to the ad. The rate is set by the seller.

etsy.name: Etsy
etsy.notes: UK sellers are charged 20% VAT on Etsy's fees. The transaction fee applies to the full order value including the shipping the buyer paid.

listingFee.note: Charged per listing, and again every four months or when the listing sells and is renewed.

paymentProcessing.note: UK rate. Etsy Payments processing varies by country.

offsiteAds.note: Charged only when a sale is attributed to an Etsy offsite advert. The cap is per order.

currencyConversionPct.note: Applies when the listing currency differs from the shop's bank currency.

amazon-uk.name: Amazon UK (FBA)
amazon-uk.notes: Referral fees are charged on the total sale price including any shipping the buyer paid. A fuel and logistics surcharge applies to fulfilment fees from April 2026. Fees shown exclude VAT.

categories.label: Clothing & accessories
categories.tierNote: Reduced rates for lower-priced items introduced in 2026.

surchargePct.note: Fuel and logistics surcharge applied to UK FBA fulfilment fees.

lowPriceThreshold.note: Low-Price FBA was expanded from £10 to £20 in January 2026.

professionalPlan.note: Flat monthly subscription, excluding VAT. Spread across the units sold in the month to get a per-unit cost.

storage.note: Monthly storage is charged per cubic metre and varies sharply between the January to September and October to December periods. Enter your own figure.

taxBands._note: Reserved for income tax, National Insurance and VAT bands. Nothing here yet — /vat/ still carries its own figures.

energyCaps._note: Reserved for Ofgem price cap unit rates and standing charges. Nothing here yet — /running-cost/ and /ev-charging-cost/ take rates from the user.
